propositions: The rebar metrics subcommand must parse --since/--until date range flags and --output json|text format, then render the full metric registry over that range as the single entry point for wiring metric readers.
The command must be routed via an explicit if sub == metrics: arm in _dispatch(), placed on the reads path after store initialization, and listed in the individual frozenset for test coverage.

The metrics.py command must import rebar.metrics (package, not just registry) to hydrate REGISTRY with reader side-effects, construct a context object with repo_root/since/until, and call registry.evaluate() for every MetricSpec.

The render loop must wrap each evaluate() call in try/except to isolate faults, composing output from MetricValue (value/source/confidence) and MetricSpec (lens), rendering unavailable metrics on error without crashing.

JSON output must be a machine-contract object with since/until strings and a metrics map where each id maps to either {lens,source,confidence,value} or {unavailable:{reason,accruing_since}}; text output must be a deterministic human summary with one line per metric in registry order.

The CLI test must import rebar.metrics before reading REGISTRY, assert REGISTRY is non-empty, and verify every registered id appears in the output as either a value or unavailable entry; a portability guard must assert metrics.py does not import rebar.metrics.adapters.
